cache_methodology: Previously read source; three sequential fresh-process repeats plus one relaxed uniform control. No cache eviction, affinity or cold-cache claim. Shared host.
notes: Final runtime test uses bounded compression candidate search without changing selection or payloads. Three repeats must have dataset hashes identical to the initial median-power result. No simultaneous imaging. Encode includes startup/inspection/error accounting/metadata/writes/integrity; verification/export/imaging excluded. Relaxed uniform MSE ceiling is 1.5 times the other profiles; compare achieved error and bytes rather than assuming matched ceilings.
